verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Haa-meem
Ayn-seen-qaaf
Kadhaalika yoohee ilayka wa ilal-ladheena min qablika Allaahul-azeezul-hakeem
Lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa huwal-aliyyul-azeem
Takaadus-samaawaatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna wal-malaa'ikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wa yastaghfiroona liman fil-ardi alaa innallaaha huwal-ghafoorur-Raheem
Wal-ladheena ittakhadhoo min doonihi awliyaa'a Allaahu hafeezun alayhim wa maa anta alayhim biwakeel
Wa kadhalika awhaynaa ilayka qur'aanan arabiyyan litundhira ummal-quraa wa man hawlahaa wa tundhira yawmal-jam'i laa rayba feehi fareequn fil-jannati wa fareequn fis-sa'eer
Wa law shaa'a Allaahu laja'alahum ummatan waahidatan wa laakin yudkhilu man yashaa'u fee rahmatihi waz-zaalimoona maa lahum min waliyyin wa laa naseer
Am ittakhadhoo min doonihi awliyaa'a fa-Allaahu huwal-waliyyu wa huwa yuhyil-mawtaa wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa makh-talaftum feehi min shay'in fahukmuhu ilaa Allaahi dhalikumu Allaahu rabbee alayhi tawakkaltu wa ilayhi uneeb
Faatirus-samaawaati wal-ardi ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwaajan wa minal-an'aam azwaajan yadhra'uukum feehi laysa kamithlihi shay'un wa huwas-samee'ul-baseer
Lahu maqaaleedus-samaawaati wal-ardi yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u wa yaqdiru innahu bikulli shay'in aleem

Shara'a lakum minad-deeni maa wassaa bihi noohan wal-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka wa maa wassaynaa bihi ibraaheema wa moosaa wa eesaa an aqeemud-deena wa laa tatafarraqoo feehi kabura alal-mushrikeena maa tad'oohum ilayhi Allaahu yajtabee ilayhi man yashaa'u wa yahdee ilayhi man yuneeb

Wa maa tafarraqoo illaa min ba'di maa jaa'ahumul-ilmu baghyan baynahum wa lawlaa kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ilaa ajalin musamman laqudiya baynahum wa innal-ladheena oorithul-kitaaba min ba'dihim lafee shakkin minhu mureeb

Falidhalika faad'u wastaqim kamaa umirta wa laa tattabi ahwaa'ahum wa qul aamantu bimaa anzala Allaahu min kitaabin wa umirtu li'dila baynakumu Allaahu rabbunaa wa rabbukum lanaa a'maalunaa wa lakum a'maalukum laa hujjata baynanaa wa baynakumu Allaahu yajma'u baynanaa wa ilayhil-maseer
Wal-ladheena yuhaajjoona fee Allaahi min ba'di mas-tujeeba lahu hujjatuhum daahidatun inda rabbihim wa alayhim ghadabun wa lahum adhaabun shadeed
Allaahul-ladhee anzalal-kitaaba bil-haqqi wal-meezaana wa maa yudreeka la-allas-saa'ata qareeb
Yasta'jilu bihal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bihaa wal-ladheena aamanoo mushfiqoona minhaa wa ya'lamoona annahal-haqqu alaa innal-ladheena yumaaroona fis-saa'ati lafee dalaalin ba'eed
Allaahu lateefun bi-ibaadihi yarzuqu man yashaa'u wa huwal-qawiyyul-azeez
Man kaana yureedu harthal-aakhirati nazid lahu fee harthihi wa man kaana yureedu harthad-dunyaa nu'tihi minhaa wa maa lahu fil-aakhirati min naseeb
Am lahum shurakaa'u shara'oo lahum minad-deeni maa lam ya'dhan bihi Allaahu wa lawlaa kalimatul-fasli laqudiya baynahum wa innaz-zaalimeena lahum adhaabun aleem
Taraz-zaalimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa kasaboo wa huwa waaqi'un bihim wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati fee rawdaatil-jannaati lahum maa yashaa'oona inda rabbihim dhaalika huwal-fadlul-kabeer

Dhaalikal-ladhee yubashshiru Allaahu ibaadahul-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati qul laa as'alukum alayhi ajran illal-mawaddata fil-qurbaa wa man yaqtarif hasanatan nazid lahu feehaa husnan innallaaha ghafoorun shakoor
Am yaqooloona iftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhiban fa-in yasha'i Allaahu yakhtim alaa qalbika wa yamhu Allaahul-baatila wa yuhiqqul-haqqa bikalimaatihi innahu aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor
Wa huwal-ladhee yaqbalut-tawbat an ibaadihi wa ya'foo anis-sayyi'aati wa ya'lamu maa taf'aloon
Wa yastajeebul-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati wa yazeeduhum min fadlihi wal-kaafiroona lahum adhaabun shadeed
Wa law basata Allaahur-rizqa li-ibaadihi labaghaw fil-ardi wa laakin yunazzilu biqadarin maa yashaa'u innahu bi-ibaadihi khabeerun baseer
Wa huwal-ladhee yunazzilul-ghaytha min ba'di maa qanatoo wa yanshuru rahmatahu wa huwal-waliyyul-hameed
Wa min aayaatihi khalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa baththa feehimaa min daabbatin wa huwa alaa jam'ihim idhaa yashaa'u qadeer
Wa maa asaabakum min museebatin fabimaa kasabat aydeekum wa ya'foo an katheer
Wa maa antum bimu'jizeena fil-ardi wa maa lakum min doonillaahi min waliyyin wa laa naseer
Wa min aayaatihil-jawaari fil-bahri kal-a'laam
In yasha yuskinir-reeha fayazlalna rawaakida alaa zahrihi inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin likulli sabbaarin shakoor
Aw yoobiqhunna bimaa kasaboo wa ya'fu an katheer
Wa ya'lamal-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaatinaa maa lahum min mahees
Famaa ooteetum min shay'in famataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa wa maa indallaahi khayrun wa abqaa lilladheena aamanoo wa alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
Wal-ladheena yajtaniboona kabaa'iral-ithmi wal-fawaahisha wa idhaa maa ghadiboo hum yaghfiroon
Wal-ladheena istajaaboo lirabbihim wa aqaamus-salaata wa amruhum shooraa baynahum wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
Wal-ladheena idhaa asaabahumul-baghyu hum yantasiroon
Wa jazaa'u sayyi'atin sayyi'atun mithluhaa faman afaa wa aslaha fa-ajruhu alaa Allaahi innahu laa yuhibbuz-zaalimeen
Wa lamani intasara ba'da zulmihi fa-ulaa'ika maa alayhim min sabeel
Innamas-sabeelu alal-ladheena yazlimoonan-naasa wa yabghoona fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi ulaa'ika lahum adhaabun aleem
Wa laman sabara wa ghafara inna dhaalika lamin azmil-umoor
Wa man yudlili Allaahu famaa lahu min waliyyin min ba'dihi wa taraz-zaalimeena lammaa ra'aw al-adhaaba yaqooloona hal ilaa maraddin min sabeel

Wa taraahum yu'radoona alayhaa khaashi'eena minadh-dhulli yanzuroona min tarfin khafiyyin wa qaalal-ladheena aamanoo innal-khaasireenal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum wa ahleehim yawmal-qiyaamati alaa innaz-zaalimeena fee adhaabin muqeem
Wa maa kaana lahum min awliyaa'a yansuroonahum min doonillaahi wa man yudlili Allaahu famaa lahu min sabeel
Istajeeboo lirabbikum min qabli an ya'tiya yawmun laa maradda lahu mina Allaahi maa lakum min malja'iin yawma'idhin wa maa lakum min nakeer

Fa-in a'radoo famaa arsalnaaka alayhim hafeezan in alayka illal-balaaghu wa innaa idhaa adhaqnal-insaana minnaa rahmatan fariha bihaa wa in tusibhum sayyi'atun bimaa qaddamat aydeehim fa-innal-insaana kafoor
Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi yakhluqu maa yashaa'u yahabu liman yashaa'u inaathan wa yahabu liman yashaa'udh-dhukoor
Aw yuzawwijuhum dhukraanan wa inaathan wa yaj'alu man yashaa'u aqeeman innahu aleemun qadeer
Wa maa kaana libasharin an yukallimahu Allaahu illaa wahyan aw min waraa'i hijaabin aw yursila rasoolan fayoohiya bi-idhnihi maa yashaa'u innahu aliyyun hakeem

Wa kadhalika awhaynaa ilayka roohan min amrinaa maa kunta tadree mal-kitaabu wa lal-eemaanu wa laakin ja'alnaahu nooran nahdee bihi man nashaa'u min ibaadinaa wa innaka latahdee ilaa siraatin mustaqeem
Siraati Allaahil-ladhee lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi alaa ilaa Allaahi taseerul-umoor
